title: catalyst journal append|adopt|redact
description: What `catalyst journal append --json`, `catalyst journal adopt --json` and `catalyst journal redact --json` print: the one journal entry the command wrote. `adopt` adds the commit it adopts and its `origin`; `redact` adds the blobs it redacted, the paths they were at and the criteria whose pins it lifted.

files.description: Each file the entry records, with its blob before and after (null: absent).

tier.description: `chore`, `fix` or `feature`; an entry written before tiers existed may lack it.

writer.description: `catalyst/<version>`: the catalyst that wrote the entry.

commit.description: adopt: the commit made outside catalyst that the entry records.

origin.description: adopt: how the change was made (`manual`).

redacted.description: redact: the blobs whose content was removed.

paths.description: redact: the paths the redacted blobs were at.

unpinned_in.description: redact: the repositories where the blobs are no longer kept.
